message.content:
This description matches a CBP ruling on "quiet books" or soft fabric books for infants. They are textile padded shapes that fold, and they are generally classified as toys (Chapter 95) rather than books (Chapter 49).

Under heading 9503, the relevant subheading is 9503.00.00 for toys. The 10-digit options include 9503.00.0073 for "other toys" and similar. Stuffed toys fall under 9503.00.0041 (stuffed toys representing animals or non-human creatures), but these are not animal shapes. Activity books for babies in fabric would fall under "Other toys; puzzles" at 9503.00.0073 ("Other"). The older structure has 9503.00.00 with statistical suffixes: 0073 is "Toys, not elsewhere specified." I will go with 9503.00.0073.
